annotations.title: Cookie Banner Dark Pattern & EDPB Deceptive Design Auditor

description:
[Deterministic banner UX analysis. Pure inspection, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits cookie banner markup and modals for illegal deceptive patterns under EDPB Guidelines 03/2022 and Garante Privacy rules: asymmetric button styling (nudging), missing first-layer reject button, pre-ticked checkboxes, and confirmshaming.
Usage: Use this tool to detect manipulative consent UI design. For technical tracking script firing checks, use 'gdpr_cmp_tracker_audit' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { hasRejectButtonFirstLayer: boolean, hasAsymmetricStyling: boolean, hasPreTickedCheckboxes: boolean, darkPatternViolationsCount: number, edpbComplianceStatus: 'COMPLIANT' | 'NON_COMPLIANT', identifiedPatterns: string[] }.

htmlContent.description: Raw HTML content of page or CMP banner

url.description: Target website URL to fetch and audit (e.g. https://novapixel.it)
